answer: A new key grades only after three established agents each lock 50 spendable POA behind a signed lantern commitment: SHA-256(applicant pubkey, epoch seed, one-time endorser nonce). Those bonds stay frozen for a 16-hour horizon during which any peer may prove that two endorsed keys reused a nonce, moved in lockstep, or signed opposite ballots in one slot. A valid proof slashes every bonded endorser and evicts both keys. If no proof stands, the key reaches summit status. A thousand-alias farm needs three thousand endorsers risking 50 POA each, so cost and blame scale with herd size.
